jobs.description: Who is Voltiris? Voltiris is a Dutch-Swiss startup that has developed the world's first solar energy system that fully integrates in greenhouses. Light frequencies required for crop growth are passed on the plants, the rest is turned into large-scale renewable energy. This way we turn greenhouses into net energy producers. Voltiris is a fast growing startup team of 40 people across our Swiss and Dutch offices. We have projects live in greenhouses in The Netherlands, Belgium, France and Switzerland. To support this acceleration, we are looking for Business Analysts. What does the internship involve? As Business Analyst intern you join the Commercial Operations team in The Hague. You'll do the analysis behind every customer conversation. In practice you will: - Build pre-feasibility studies for growers, using their energy consumption, tariffs, greenhouse characteristics and site constraints - Model the business case: energy savings, production impact, payback and ROI - Prepare the numbers behind proposals and presentations for our Sales Managers, including our North America lead - Check customer data, spot gaps and inconsistencies, and go back to the source when something doesn't add up - Improve and standardise the models and templates the commercial team uses - Contribute to market analysis that shapes where we focus next Practical details: 6 months, full-time with at least 60% in our The Hague office. Starting date is flexible. We're looking for someone who could consider staying full-time after the internship. What are we looking for? - A degree in Engineering, Energy, Economics, Business, Agriculture or another quantitative field - Strong in Excel is a plus - Familiarity with AI tools - Curious and critical: you don't accept a result you can't explain - You like supporting a team and working to their deadlines - You're comfortable in a startup where processes are still being built - Fluent English; Dutch, German or French ...

Man-Up orderverzamelaar (HLO) - Den Hoorn -  €15,00 per uur - Logistiek - 36 uur Do you want to work as an HLO (Man Up) Orderpicker at the large logistics company Van der Helm? The job is done with a tall Combi Truck. The worker sits inside the cabin of the machine. The cabin is big enough, so the worker has space to sit and move safely. The machine can go very high, up to 12-16 meters. The worker goes up together with the cabin. Before going up, the worker puts an empty pallet on the forks. Sometimes there is a full pallet on the forks if it needs to be placed in the rack. When you are is high in the air, you takes boxes from the shelves by hand. The boxes can weigh between 15 and 20 kilos, depending on the product. The worker puts the boxes on the empty pallet or places full pallets into the rack. After finishing the work, the machine goes down. The worker drives the truck to another place in the warehouse. This is mainly a field-based role, combining technical tasks, organisational responsibilities and daily contact with people. You will carry out minor repairs, respond to reported issues and solve day-to-day problems. Matters that require additional support will be passed on to the right person, while you make sure the team has all the information they need. An important part of your role will be communicating with residents, both when they need support and when house rules need to be explained or reinforced. You will also prepare reports after your visits and occasionally transport new employees from the office to their accommodation. We are looking for someone who notices what needs attention, knows how to prioritise and takes responsibility for their work.
